title: Tradescantia Zebrina Burgundy - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Deep Burgundy
description:
Stunning Trailing Houseplant with Rich Burgundy and Silver Foliage


KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant burgundy and silver-purple variegated foliage
• Easy to grow and maintain, perfect for beginners
• Fast-growing with a beautiful trailing habit
• Ideal for hanging baskets, shelves, or terrariums
• Adds a dramatic splash of colour to any indoor space


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Tradescantia zebrina 'Burgundy'
Colour: Burgundy, silver, purple
Season: Year-round (foliage); small, inconspicuous pink/purple flowers may appear
Growth Habit: Trailing


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Bright, indirect light
Soil: Well-draining potting mix
Watering: Keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged; allow top inch to dry between waterings
Spacing: 15-30 cm apart for bushy growth
Height: Up to 15-20 cm (foliage height), trails up to 60 cm+
Spread: 30-60 cm (trailing spread)
Hardiness: H1B (Tender, min 5°C)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Place in a location with bright, indirect sunlight to maintain vibrant foliage colour. Avoid direct harsh sun.
• Water thoroughly when the top inch of soil feels dry. Reduce watering slightly in winter.
• Provide high humidity if possible, by misting regularly or placing on a pebble tray.
• Feed with a balanced liquid fertiliser every 2-4 weeks during spring and summer.
• Pinch back stems regularly to encourage bushier growth and prevent legginess.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
